title: Catalyst: first-touch onboarding tiles & minimal checklist artboards
creator: Maya Chen
description: Create a compact set of onboarding tile artboards and a minimal first-touch checklist for the Console first-run experience. Deliverables: vector tile illustrations (light + dark), annotated product screenshots for three empty states (no projects, no models, no routes), a compact checklist component artboard (progressive reveal), tooltip copy variants, and export-ready assets (SVG/PNG/JSON for motion). Focus: low cognitive load, fast scan, and clear next actions that map to both Hosted API quickstarts and Dedicated/Private setup flows. Include motion spec for a subtle entrance + success microinteraction for completed checklist items. Constraints: must fit within the existing console header grid (320–1280px), match Redwood brand tokens, and meet AA contrast. Avoid heavy photographic imagery; prefer geometric vector metaphors that scale across densities.
acceptance_criteria: Deliver 8 tile illustrations (4 light / 4 dark) exported as SVG and 2x PNG
Provide 3 annotated console screenshots with hotspots and short action copy for empty states
Final artboards include accessible color tokens and contrast notes; pass AA for body and icons
Checklist component artboard includes states: empty, in-progress, completed, error; motion spec included
Figma file organized with export slices and a brief designer handoff checklist
comments: 2026-02-11 — Initial wireframes uploaded to Figma. I used a modular 3x2 tile grid so marketing and product can swap content without layout changes. — Maya

2026-02-13 — PM review (Kaitlin Rivera): prefer 'Quickstart' label to map to free credits flow; suggested stronger CTA on the 'Provision Dedicated' tile to reduce churn. Action: add alternative copy variants. — Maya

2026-02-14 — Eng sync (Luca Moreno): recommended avoiding large PNGs for the empty-state hero; requested SVGs + runtime annotations for screenshot overlays to be implemented as HTML/CSS in the console for localization. Added note to handoff. — Arjun

2026-02-16 — Usability test (n=6 early adopters): users skimmed tiles but were confused by 'Private' phrasing; they expected 'Self-host' or 'On-prem'. Recommend swap copy and run A/B test during canary. — Research (Elena Gomes)

2026-02-19 — Design review: narrowed visual direction to 'geometric lighthouse' motif to align with product metaphors. Decided to trade one decorative tile for an action-oriented walkthrough tile. Preparing final exports. — Maya
2026-02-20 — Handoff checklist drafted and shared with engineering and PM in Confluence. Requesting review from Accessibility lead before final export. — Maya
accessibility_notes: Use brand token --rw-text-primary for headings; ensure 4.5:1 contrast for all body text
Provide explicit focus styles for checklist items and actionable tiles
All hotspot copy should be localizable; export copy keys in handoff sheet
screenshot_requirements: Include console URL bar and left nav collapsed/expanded for context
Overlay actionable hotspots with 40–80px callouts and 2-line max copy
Produce one screenshot variant per region (NA/EU) showing region picker in header
motion_specs: Entrance: 150ms scale+fade from 0.98 to 1 with ease-out cubic
Checklist tick: 220ms stroke draw + 160ms fill flash; follow-up micro-bounce 80ms
Error: shake 180ms with orange 20% opacity pulse
